main.description: Describes where a community's account lives and whether the AppView can still act for it. Only administrators of the community can read it.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks permission for this community.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at that identifier.

kind.description: colibri when the account lives on this AppView's server and the AppView holds its password. own when the account belongs to the community's owner and the AppView acts through a sign-in.

account.description: The account's handle, or its DID when it has none.

server.description: The server the account lives on, as the AppView last reached it.

connectedBy.description: The user who signed in as the account, for kind own.

connectedAt.description: When the AppView was last connected to the account.

needsSignIn.description: Whether the AppView lost access and needs the owner to sign in again. New writes fail until then.

handOverExpiresAt.description: When the password from handOverHost stops working, while a hand-over is active.

hostingView.description: Where a community's account lives and whether the AppView can act for it.
